title: Test writer
skill: Show the agent the exact shape you want

good: Create tests/test_duration.py for parse_duration() in duration.py. Use unittest and start the file like tests/test_smoke.py (sys.path insert). Table-test format: CASES = [('2h', 7200), ('5m', 300), ('9s', 9), ('1h30m', 5400), ('1h2m3s', 3723), (' 1H 30M ', 5400), ('0s', 0)] and ERRORS = ['', '   ', '5d', '30m1h', '1h2h', '10m5']. One test loops over CASES with self.subTest and assertEqual; one loops over ERRORS with self.subTest and assertRaises(ValueError). Do not change duration.py. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: Write some tests for the duration parser.
